5326.title: SDK scanner interprets non-import syntax as dependencies
5326.rootCauseOneLine: Raw-source regexes mistake property methods, property calls, comments, and string contents for module imports.
5326.proposedFix: Use syntax-aware extraction while retaining dependency policy; choose a parser compatible with the SDK's existing ESM packaging contract.
5326.caveats: The local candidate passes scanner regressions but fails the published ESM runtime contract. It was stopped without a push or PR. Published npm releases were not retested.
